Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Hi I might have a very stupid question, but suddenly I got very
unsecure. Here is the question:
If there is an effect on a minion to burn something. May they then
burn more of that to gain more of the same effect?
Exsample:
Maman Boumba
Clan: Imbued (group 4)
Capacity: 4
Disciplines: inn mar
During a referendum, Maman may burn a conviction [1 CONVICTION] to get
3 votes against the referendum. You may tap Maman before range is
determined in a combat between two monsters to end that combat.

-May she burn 2 conviction to get 6 votes?

Amaravati
Clan: Assamite (group 4)
Capacity: 8
Disciplines: DOM OBF QUI ani chi
Independent: During a political action, Amaravati may burn 2 blood to
give each ready Assamite you control an additional vote. Blood Cursed.

-May Amaravati burn 4 blood to give each assamite 2 votes?

Callirus
Clan: Ravnos (group 4)
Capacity: 5
Disciplines: CHI FOR ani
Independent: During your untap phase, Callirus can burn 1 blood to
burn one card on him.

-may Callirus burn 2 blood to burn 2 cards?

You get the my meaning.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Hi I might have a very stupid question, but suddenly I got very
> unsecure. Here is the question:
> If there is an effect on a minion to burn something. May they then
> burn more of that to gain more of the same effect?

Depends on whether card text allows it.

> Exsample:
> Maman Boumba
> Clan: Imbued (group 4)
> Capacity: 4
> Disciplines: inn mar
> During a referendum, Maman may burn a conviction [1 CONVICTION] to get
> 3 votes against the referendum. You may tap Maman before range is
> determined in a combat between two monsters to end that combat.
>
> -May she burn 2 conviction to get 6 votes?

No. "During X, do Y" limits Y to once per X.
So Once each referendum, Maman may burn a conviction to...

> Amaravati
> Clan: Assamite (group 4)
> Capacity: 8
> Disciplines: DOM OBF QUI ani chi
> Independent: During a political action, Amaravati may burn 2 blood to
> give each ready Assamite you control an additional vote. Blood Cursed.
>
> -May Amaravati burn 4 blood to give each assamite 2 votes?

No.

> Callirus
> Clan: Ravnos (group 4)
> Capacity: 5
> Disciplines: CHI FOR ani
> Independent: During your untap phase, Callirus can burn 1 blood to
> burn one card on him.
>
> -may Callirus burn 2 blood to burn 2 cards?

No.

> You get the my meaning.

Yes.
